{{Quote|''Droids'', Sarge! They're coming through the walls!"<br />"Don't whine about it, Private&mdash;''fight back''!|The clone private and his sergeant|<ref name="mm">{{TCWComicCite|6.41|Mandalorian Memories}}</ref>}}
A '''clone trooper private''' was stationed in [[Timira City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He helped defend the [[Jedi Research Facility]] from an [[Korasa job|attack]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] seeking the [[Blade of Beginnings]].
